companyContext: Stellantis is the multinational automotive group that owns and operates the Peugeot brand. Peugeot SA, founded in 1810 and headquartered in France, designs, manufactures and markets passenger cars, commercial vehicles and electrified vehicles distributed worldwide.
brandContext: Peugeot is a French generalist-premium car manufacturer offering a full line-up of thermal, hybrid, plug-in hybrid and 100% electric vehicles (208, 2008, 308, 308 SW, 3008, 5008, 408, Rifter, Traveller, Partner, Expert, Boxer). The pro/business division promotes its current range with dedicated offers for professionals, including the Nouvelle 308 SW range featured on the gamme-thermique campaign page.

brandVision: Allure, Emotion, Excellence — an innovative high-end generalist brand joining history and hyper-modernity, with the energy transition and zero-carbon mobility at the heart of its strategy. Peugeot blends timeless French elegance, bold design (illuminated lion shield, i-Cockpit, sharp Matrix LED light signature) and electrified performance to deliver a fluid, premium customer experience across every touchpoint.
brandValues: Quality, timelessness, assertiveness; French savoir-faire and Mulhouse-made craftsmanship; responsible design (>30% recycled & renewable materials, 85% recyclability); driving pleasure through the PEUGEOT i-Cockpit; protection and longevity symbolized by the lion shield (prestige, confidence, lineage); accessible premium for both private and professional customers.
